findings.title: Prepared reception becomes settled residence
findings.claim: Within the positive destination sequence, sound action reaches an enclosed garden and prepared lodging whose adequacy is shown by abiding there without seeking a transfer.
findings.mechanism: The 18:107 occurrences of intentional action, soundness, the tree-covered garden, and guest-provision meet the focus occurrences of enduring residence, directed seeking, and change of place or state; the contact turns prepared reception into a settled home whose residents have no onward lodging to pursue.
findings.reader_payoff: The focus becomes more than a statement of duration: the reader sees why arrival has become belonging.
findings.containment: This is a pericope-grounded contextual resonance alongside the ordinary claim that they remain in the garden; it does not establish a surah-wide system or replace the plain residence reading.

epistemic.reason: The source supplies trusted context and branch nominations with exact focus and context anchors; the integrated reception-to-home relation remains an interpretive synthesis.
